title: Kissed Chewy Chinese Noodles Chow Fun
description: A cultured and chewy Chinese dish featuring tamarind paste, this halal-friendly meal prep recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner, shaped like nigiri for a unique twist.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions.
In a small bowl, whisk together the tamarind paste, soy sauce, and vegetable oil to make the sauce.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil over medium heat and add the chopped scallions, grated ginger, and minced garlic.
Cook the scallion mixture for 2-3 minutes, or until fragrant, then add the cooked noodles and sauce to the skillet.
Stir everything together to combine, then season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Using your hands, shape the noodle mixture into small nigiri shapes, about 1 1/2 inches long and 1 inch wide.
Serve the Kissed Chewy Chinese Noodles Chow Fun warm, garnished with additional chopped scallions if desired.
Let the dish cool completely before refrigerating or freezing for later meal prep.
Reheat the noodles in the microwave or on the stovetop before serving.
